rules.rule_description: All loan applications must follow the exact sequence: Application Received → Document Verification → Income Verification → Credit Check → Risk Assessment → Manager Approval (for loans > $10,000) → Final Approval → Disbursement
rules.condition_logic: Steps must be completed in exact order. Skipping steps is prohibited.

rules.rule_description: Application Received must be the first step in the workflow
Document Verification must follow Application Received
Income Verification must follow Document Verification
Credit Check must follow Income Verification
Risk Assessment must follow Credit Check
Manager Approval must follow Risk Assessment for loans exceeding $10,000
rules.condition_logic: Sixth step in mandatory sequence, conditional on loan_amount > 10000

rules.rule_description: Final Approval must follow Manager Approval (or Risk Assessment if Manager Approval not required)
Disbursement must be the final step after Final Approval
rules.condition_logic: Eighth and final step in mandatory sequence

rules.rule_description: Skipping workflow steps is strictly prohibited
rules.condition_logic: All steps in sequence must be completed; no steps can be bypassed

rules.rule_description: Loans up to $10,000 require Level 1 Officer approval only
Loans between $10,001 and $50,000 require Level 1 Officer approval AND Manager Approval
Loans above $50,000 require Level 1 Officer approval AND Manager Approval AND Senior Manager Approval
Self-approval is strictly prohibited. The same officer cannot approve their own processing
rules.condition_logic: processing_officer_id != approving_officer_id for all approval stages

rules.rule_description: Manager Approval is mandatory for all loans exceeding $10,000
Document Verification must be completed within 24 hours of application
Credit Check must be completed within 48 hours of application
Total processing time must be minimum 2 hours to ensure due diligence
Total processing time must be maximum 7 days from application to disbursement
Rushed processing (completing entire workflow in less than 2 hours) indicates insufficient due diligence and is prohibited
Minimum credit score requirement is 600
Loans with credit score below 650 require Risk Assessment sign-off
Loans with credit score below 600 must be rejected unless Senior Manager exception approval is obtained
rules.condition_logic: IF credit_score < 600 THEN (application_status = rejected OR senior_manager_exception_approval = true)

rules.rule_description: Minimum borrower age is 21 years
Maximum borrower age is 65 years
Government-issued ID is mandatory and must be current (not expired)
rules.condition_logic: government_id is present AND government_id_expiry_date >= current_date

rules.rule_description: Proof of Income (salary slips, bank statements) is mandatory
Address Proof is mandatory
Credit Report is mandatory
All mandatory documents must be verified before proceeding to Risk Assessment stage
rules.condition_logic: All mandatory documents verified before risk_assessment_stage

rules.rule_description: All approvals must be completed before disbursement
Final approval must be obtained before disbursement
Loan agreement must be signed before disbursement
Bank account verification must be completed before disbursement
Quality check must be performed within 48 hours of disbursement
Post-disbursement QC must verify all documents and approvals are in order
Case ID is mandatory for all workflow entries
rules.condition_logic: case_id must be present and valid for all workflow entries

rules.rule_description: Officer ID is mandatory for all workflow entries
rules.condition_logic: officer_id must be present and valid for all workflow entries

pattern_analysis.overall_summary: Analysis of 466 deviations across 7 loan cases reveals systemic compliance failures driven by three primary factors: (1) Universal mandate setup failure affecting 100% of disbursements, (2) Systematic bypass of manager approval requirements in 5 of 7 cases, and (3) Process confusion between documented and actual workflow steps. The deviation pattern suggests institutional knowledge gaps rather than isolated officer errors, with all 6 officers exhibiting similar non-compliance behaviors. Critical risk: loans are being disbursed without essential controls, creating significant financial and regulatory exposure.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: All officers (EMP-101, EMP-103, EMP-104, EMP-105, EMP-106) consistently fail to set up EMI mandate/NACH before disbursement across 100% of cases
behavioral_patterns.supporting_evidence: Every single loan case (LOAN-001 through LOAN-007) shows mandate_not_set_before_disbursement deviation. This is not officer-specific but a systemic process failure affecting all staff uniformly.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: Officers EMP-101, EMP-103, EMP-104, EMP-105 systematically skip manager approval step, with self-approval or no approval occurring in 71% of cases
behavioral_patterns.supporting_evidence: Notes explicitly state 'Self-approved by same officer who processed' (LOAN-004), 'Approved without manager sign-off' (LOAN-005), 'Approved despite low score - needs review' (LOAN-003). Only LOAN-001 and LOAN-007 show proper manager approval.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: Officers claim documents are verified in notes but system shows missing mandatory documents (address_proof, bank_statement, identity_proof) in 100% of cases
behavioral_patterns.supporting_evidence: Contradiction between notes stating 'All docs verified' (LOAN-004), 'Extensive doc check' (LOAN-007) and actual missing documents. Suggests either documentation system failure or officers marking verification without actual completion.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: High-risk loans (low credit scores) receive expedited processing with explicit acknowledgment of risk but no additional controls
behavioral_patterns.supporting_evidence: LOAN-003: Credit score 590 (below threshold), marked 'High risk due to low credit score' yet 'Approved despite low score' with 'Rushed disbursement'. LOAN-005: Score 640, 'Emergency personal loan' with 'Quick disbursement' and 'Approved without manager sign-off'.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: Audit trail systematically missing for critical approval steps (manager approval, final approval, disbursement) across 60 deviations
behavioral_patterns.supporting_evidence: Critical steps lack audit_trail_id or source_system tracking. This prevents verification of who actually performed approvals and when, creating accountability gaps.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: Process workflow confusion: 305 deviations (65.45%) involve unexpected_step or missing_step, suggesting documented SOP does not match actual practice
behavioral_patterns.supporting_evidence: Steps like 'DOCUMENT VERIFICATION', 'RISK ASSESSMENT', 'APPLICATION RECEIVED' flagged as unexpected, while 'Credit Check', 'Risk Assessment' flagged as missing. Indicates SOP documentation is outdated or officers follow undocumented parallel process.

hidden_rules.rule: Emergency/urgent loans bypass manager approval requirement - officers self-approve or skip approval entirely
hidden_rules.evidence: LOAN-005 explicitly notes 'Emergency personal loan' with 'Quick verification', 'Approved without manager sign-off', 'Quick disbursement'. LOAN-003 shows 'Rushed disbursement'. Pattern suggests informal fast-track process for urgent cases.
hidden_rules.compliance_impact: Critical - Violates segregation of duties and dual control principles. Creates fraud risk and eliminates independent review for potentially high-risk urgent requests.

hidden_rules.rule: High-value loans (mortgages >$50k) proceed without required senior manager approval when regular manager has approved
hidden_rules.evidence: LOAN-007 notes explicitly state 'Missing senior manager approval for amount > $50k' yet loan was disbursed. Manager approval was obtained but senior manager approval was skipped. Suggests officers believe manager approval is sufficient regardless of amount threshold.
hidden_rules.compliance_impact: Critical - Violates approval authority limits. Exposes organization to unauthorized large disbursements and exceeds individual manager's approval authority.

hidden_rules.rule: Document verification step is performed but not formally recorded in system, leading to 'missing document' flags despite notes claiming verification completed
hidden_rules.evidence: Multiple cases show notes stating 'All docs verified' (LOAN-004), 'Documents verified' (LOAN-002), 'Extensive doc check' (LOAN-007) but system flags missing mandatory documents. Suggests parallel paper-based or offline verification process not integrated with system.
hidden_rules.compliance_impact: High - Creates audit trail gaps and prevents verification of actual document review. Risk of loans proceeding without proper documentation despite claims of verification.

hidden_rules.rule: EMI mandate setup is treated as post-disbursement activity rather than pre-disbursement requirement
hidden_rules.evidence: 100% of cases (all 7 loans) show mandate_not_set_before_disbursement. Universal pattern across all officers and loan types suggests this is accepted practice, not isolated errors. No notes indicate awareness this is a deviation.
hidden_rules.compliance_impact: Critical - Violates loan disbursement controls. Creates repayment risk as EMI collection mechanism not in place at disbursement. Suggests fundamental misunderstanding of mandate setup timing requirements.

hidden_rules.rule: Credit checks and risk assessments are performed but recorded in non-standard workflow steps, causing system to flag them as both 'unexpected' and 'missing'
hidden_rules.evidence: Same cases show both 'unexpected_step: RISK ASSESSMENT' and 'missing_step: Risk Assessment'. Notes confirm these steps were performed (e.g., 'Credit score: 720', 'Low risk profile'). Indicates officers use different step names or sequence than SOP defines.
hidden_rules.compliance_impact: Medium - While actual risk assessment occurs, non-standard recording creates compliance reporting issues and prevents proper workflow monitoring. Suggests need for SOP update or system configuration change.

hidden_rules.rule: Small personal loans are fast-tracked with reduced verification steps under informal 'low-risk small loan' exception
hidden_rules.evidence: LOAN-002 notes: 'Quick personal loan', 'Small loan - fast tracked'. LOAN-006: 'Small personal loan' with 'Documents not fully verified - need to check' yet approved and disbursed. Suggests informal risk-based approach not documented in SOP.
hidden_rules.compliance_impact: High - Creates inconsistent application of controls based on undocumented criteria. Risk of small loans accumulating significant exposure or being exploited for fraud.

systemic_issues.issue: EMI mandate setup process not integrated into pre-disbursement workflow - appears to be manual post-disbursement activity
systemic_issues.impact: All loans disbursed without repayment mechanism in place. Creates operational risk for collections and violates lending best practices. Suggests mandate setup is separate system or manual process not linked to loan origination system.
systemic_issues.recommended_fix: Integrate mandate setup as mandatory pre-disbursement step in loan origination system with hard stop preventing disbursement until mandate confirmed. Alternatively, if business requires disbursement before mandate, update SOP to reflect actual practice and implement compensating controls.

systemic_issues.issue: Manager approval workflow not enforced by system - relies on officer discretion to route for approval
systemic_issues.impact: Officers can self-approve or skip manager approval entirely. Notes show awareness ('Self-approved by same officer', 'Approved without manager sign-off') but no system prevention. Creates segregation of duties failure and fraud risk.
systemic_issues.recommended_fix: Implement system-enforced approval routing based on loan amount, risk rating, and officer authority level. Remove officer ability to bypass approval workflow. Add automated escalation for pending approvals.

systemic_issues.issue: Document management system not integrated with loan workflow - creates disconnect between claimed verification and system records
systemic_issues.frequency: 28 occurrences (all cases show missing documents despite verification claims)
systemic_issues.impact: Officers perform document checks but system cannot verify completion. Creates audit trail gaps and prevents automated compliance monitoring. Risk of loans proceeding without actual document review despite officer attestations.
systemic_issues.recommended_fix: Integrate document management system with loan workflow requiring digital upload and verification checkoff before proceeding to next stage. Implement document checklist with mandatory sign-off tracked in audit trail.

systemic_issues.issue: Audit trail system not capturing critical approval and disbursement actions - 60 instances of missing audit information
systemic_issues.impact: Cannot verify who performed critical actions, when they occurred, or what data was reviewed. Prevents forensic investigation of issues and creates regulatory compliance risk. Particularly problematic for manager approvals and disbursements.
systemic_issues.recommended_fix: Implement comprehensive audit logging for all critical workflow steps capturing user ID, timestamp, IP address, and key data values. Ensure audit trail cannot be disabled or bypassed. Add automated monitoring for missing audit records.

systemic_issues.issue: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documentation does not match actual workflow - 305 step sequence deviations
systemic_issues.impact: Officers follow undocumented process while system enforces different documented process. Creates massive false positive deviation reporting (305 of 466 deviations may be process documentation issues rather than true violations). Undermines compliance monitoring effectiveness.
systemic_issues.recommended_fix: Conduct workflow analysis to document actual current state process. Update SOP to reflect reality or retrain officers on documented process. Reconfigure system workflow validation rules to match agreed process. Eliminate disconnect between documentation and practice.

systemic_issues.issue: Post-disbursement quality check process not implemented or not tracked in system
systemic_issues.impact: No secondary review of completed loans to catch errors before they become losses. Eliminates key control for detecting processing mistakes, fraud, or documentation gaps.
systemic_issues.recommended_fix: Implement mandatory post-disbursement QC process with random sampling or risk-based selection. Track QC completion in system with findings and remediation actions. Assign QC to independent team separate from origination.

time_patterns.pattern: All 466 deviations occurred during evening hours (6pm-12am) with peak at 7pm-10pm (21:00, 19:00 peak hours)
time_patterns.reason: 100% evening concentration suggests either: (1) Batch processing or system jobs running in evening creating deviation flags, (2) Second shift operations with different supervision/controls, (3) Officers rushing to complete end-of-day processing, or (4) System timestamp issue not reflecting actual transaction time
time_patterns.recommendation: Investigate whether evening concentration reflects actual processing time or system artifact. If actual evening processing, assess whether reduced supervision or end-of-day pressure contributes to deviations. Consider enhanced monitoring or approval requirements for evening transactions.

time_patterns.pattern: Thursday shows highest deviation concentration (peak day identified in temporal analysis)
time_patterns.reason: Mid-week peak unusual - typically month-end or week-end show spikes. May indicate: (1) Weekly processing cycle with Thursday deadline, (2) Workload accumulation from early week, (3) Staff scheduling pattern (reduced supervision on Thursdays), or (4) System maintenance or batch job schedule
time_patterns.recommendation: Analyze Thursday workload and staffing patterns. If Thursday is processing deadline, consider workload distribution across week. Assess whether Thursday has reduced management oversight requiring additional controls.

time_patterns.pattern: Deviations appear in clusters at specific timestamps (21:56:06-07, 21:46:49-50, 21:36:30, 19:51:40-41) suggesting batch processing or bulk data loads
time_patterns.reason: Multiple deviations with identical or near-identical timestamps indicate automated system processing rather than real-time officer actions. Suggests deviation detection runs as scheduled job analyzing completed transactions in batches.
time_patterns.recommendation: Confirm deviation detection methodology. If batch processing, ensure timely detection and notification to prevent pattern continuation. Consider real-time validation at point of transaction to prevent deviations rather than detecting after completion.

most_common_reasons.reason: Emergency/urgent processing - expedited handling for time-sensitive customer requests
Process confusion - officers following undocumented workflow different from system-defined SOP
System limitation - mandate setup, document verification, audit trail not integrated with workflow
Self-approval/missing approval - officers bypassing required manager review
High-risk acceptance - conscious decision to approve despite risk indicators
